title: The Imaginary Invalid and the Housewarming

scenes.title: The Call on Speakerphone
scenes.summary: While cooking dinner for Elena, Chef Barinov is caught in a lie when Lyova calls on speakerphone asking about his supposed illness.

scenes.title: The Caravan and the Oasis
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Ainura teases Gulya about how shy Lyova is, while Elena schedules Victor's medical checkup with her doctor friend Anya.

scenes.title: A Shoulder for Katya to Lean On
scenes.summary: Kostya and Nastya argue over whether Denis or Nikita is a better match for a heartbroken Katya before agreeing not to meddle.

scenes.title: The Checkup Instead of the Chef
scenes.summary: Nastya offers to help Nikita win Katya's heart, while Chef Barinov glues a fake mustache onto Lyova and sends him to the clinic in his place.

scenes.title: Blue Shoe Covers
scenes.summary: Gulya catches Lyova returning from the clinic in blue hospital shoe covers, and Nastya invites Katya out for drinks after work.

scenes.title: Girls' Night for Two
scenes.summary: Gulya overhears Chef Barinov joking about dying at any moment and assumes Lyova is terminally ill, while Nastya gets Katya alone at the bar.

scenes.title: Extra Guests at the Bar
scenes.summary: After Kostya's attempt to seat Denis with Katya fails, Nikita joins the girls at the bar, and Doctor Anya calls Elena with the lab results.

scenes.title: The Cherry Cocktail
scenes.summary: Elena learns that Victor's supposed test results show remarkably high youthful hormones, while Kostya mixes a knockout cocktail for Nikita.

scenes.title: Who Drank the Cocktail
scenes.summary: While Kostya steps away, Nikita gallantly offers the pretty Cherry cocktail to Nastya, who drinks it down to the bottom.

scenes.title: The Way Home
scenes.summary: Kostya has to haul an unruly, tipsy Nastya home in a taxi with Katya's help, while Gulya anxiously asks Lyova about his health.

scenes.title: Lunch for the Chief Doctor
scenes.summary: Ainura urges Gulya to leave Lyova before his illness gets worse, while Elena tells Chef Barinov that Doctor Anya and her husband have arrived for lunch.

scenes.title: Lyova Without a Mustache
scenes.summary: Sent out to greet Doctor Anya and her husband as Victor, a bare-faced Lyova claims he shaved off his mustache to look younger.

scenes.title: The Unexpected Housewarming
scenes.summary: At home, Kostya and Nastya discover they have both invited Katya to a fake housewarming party that evening.

scenes.title: Gulya's Promise
scenes.summary: Elena calls Chef Barinov believing he shaved his mustache, while Gulya corners Lyova and promises not to abandon him before he dies.

scenes.title: A Farewell Gift
scenes.summary: When Lyova learns his mother is going to the dacha, Gulya kisses him passionately by the elevator right in front of Doctor Anya.

scenes.title: All the Guests Gathered
scenes.summary: At Kostya and Nastya's apartment, first Denis arrives on Kostya's invitation and then Nikita arrives on Nastya's, creating an awkward dinner.

scenes.title: Interrogation in the Office
scenes.summary: While Gulya visits Lyova at his apartment, a furious Elena bursts into Chef Barinov's office demanding to know who shaved his mustache and kissed a coworker.

scenes.title: Nastya's Mushrooms
scenes.summary: At the housewarming table, Nikita praises Nastya's mushrooms while Denis lets slip that Kostya mixed the Cherry cocktail to knock guests out.

scenes.title: Matchmakers in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Nastya and Kostya confront each other over secretly trying to set Katya up with Nikita and Denis, sparking a marital quarrel.

scenes.title: The Truth About the Tests
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov calls Lyova and makes him confess to Elena that he took the medical tests in Victor's place, relieving a stunned Gulya.
